'''''Artemisia gorgonum''''' is a species of flowering plants of the family [[Asteraceae]], endemic to [[Cape Verde]].<ref name="WoRMS">{{WRMS species|1083661|''Artemisia gorgonum'' Webb||24 January 2019}}</ref> Its local name is ''losna'' or ''lasna''. The plant plays a role in [[traditional medicine]].<ref>{{cite web|author=Gomes, A.|author2=Vasconcelos, T.|author3=Almeida, H.|name-list-style=amp|title=Plantas na medicina tradicional de Cabo Verde|trans-title=Medicinal Traditional Plants in Cape Verde|language=pt|year=2008|url=http://www2.iict.pt/archive/doc/MH_Almeida_wrkshp_plts_medic.pdf|access-date=2016-03-19|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170329135958/http://www2.iict.pt/archive/doc/MH_Almeida_wrkshp_plts_medic.pdf|archive-date=2017-03-29}}</ref>

==Description==
''Artemisia gorgonum'' is an aromatic shrub that can reach 2 metres. It has small yellow flowers.<ref>[http://www.iict.pt/ev/plantas/Textos/fichaCV3_en.pdf ''Artemisia gorgonum''], Instituto de Investigação Científica Tropical</ref>

==Distribution and ecology==
''Artemisia gorgonum'' occurs in the islands of [[Santo Antão, Cape Verde|Santo Antão]], [[Santiago]] and [[Fogo, Cape Verde|Fogo]],<ref>Oromí, Martín, Zurita & Cabrera, 2005 : ''[http://www.gobiernodecanarias.org/opencms8/export/sites/medioambiente/piac/galerias/descargas/Documentos/Publicaciones/Publicaciones-LPESCaboVerde.pdf Lista preliminar de especies silvestres de Cabo Verde: Hongos, Plantas y Animales Terrestres.]'' Gobierno de Canarias, Consejería de Medio Ambiente y Ordenación Territorial, p. 40</ref> in semi-arid, subhumid and humid zones. It grows mainly on plains and stony slopes. The main altitudinal distribution is between 800 m and 2000 m.<ref name="iucn status 20 November 2021" />
